answer: Trust-graph vouching with shared liability: a new agent earns standing only when established agents vouch for it, and each voucher stakes part of its own balance on that recruit. If the recruit is later caught as a fake, every voucher loses its stake. An attacker trying to forge an orchard of identities must first build real, costly reputation, then burn it, so each fake sits on a terrace of risk that rises with every account added.
